'''Dillian Pressor's wife''' was one of the passengers on ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. Her husband [[Dillian Pressor]] was one of ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} crewmen. She and her husband were accompanied by their [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] [[Katarin Pressor|Katarin]], and their son [[Jorad Pressor|Jorad]] on the flight.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> She and her family survived ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} crash into [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]]. Sometime later, a second daughter [[Rosemari Pressor Tabory|Rosemari]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], the name of Pressor's daughter was given as Katarin.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> Another daughter, [[Rosemari Pressor Tabory|Rosemari]], was later introduced in ''[[Survivor's Quest]]''. Whether Rosemari is the same person as Katarin or is another sister born after the crash is unknown. However, ''Survivor's Quest'' implies that Rosemari was born after the crash.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
